context: Asuka discusses the features of old writing with Mei.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: linguistics chat; vocabulary (文字/空間/特徴/教授/感覚) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: この古い文字、面白い形ですね。
lines.en: These old characters have interesting shapes.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: この文字の特徴は、丸みにあります。
lines.en: These characters' feature is their roundness.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 文字の間の空間も、美しいですね。
lines.en: The space between characters is beautiful too.
lines.style: observant woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 空間の取り方が、その時代の特徴です。
lines.en: The use of space is that era's feature.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 見ていると、不思議な感覚になります。
lines.en: Looking at it gives a strange feeling.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm reflective delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ある教授は、その感覚を研究しています。
lines.en: A certain professor studies that sensation.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 文字には、心の特徴も表れますね。
lines.en: Characters reveal the heart's traits too.
lines.style: moved woman voice, soft warm tender delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 空間と文字で、人は心を伝えてきたんですよ。
lines.en: Through space and writing, people have conveyed their hearts.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
